originality.rationale: Figure 5 of Klanderman et al. covers all possible six-polynomial forms, so that aspect is expressly prior art. The accepted object is instead the exact six-class incidence vector of all 38760 six-subsets of the concrete Paley twenty-frame together with 1140 switching-transitive worst masks. Neither the earlier full Seidel table, the original Paley construction, cyclic-erasure papers nor the published five-compression census determine these labelled counts; the claim has been checked for logical implication rather than only word overlap.
residual_risks: Unindexed earlier enumeration of six-vertex tournament patterns inside the bordered Paley conference matrix of order twenty could imply these exact counts.
The universal sextet of six-by-six spectral types is explicitly known and not claimed original.
The result is a computationally certified finite exact incidence statement, not a symbolic multiplicity formula for every skew-conference order.

value.rationale: The six-mask erasure distribution is a natural unknown finite invariant of the canonical 20-vector Paley conference Parseval frame: all six known Seidel spectral classes actually occur and their exact frequencies quantify six-recovery regimes. The exact worst 1140 masks have structural switching-transitive characterization; the precise lower frame bound is needed to evaluate robustness at the first Paley order with every class. This is not a routine restatement of the universal six-polynomial table or the five-column dichotomy.
